if: input tax credit is claimed on a supply
the details of input tax credit in respect of that supply, communicated to the registered person under section 38, HAVE been restricted
then: CONFLICT — one locally held source makes non-restriction a condition of the credit; the other does not contain the clause at all. Neither is adopted here
note: Absent from the primary source, the Act as updated 31-08-2021. The IndiaCode consolidated text as on 11-06-2026 carries it and footnotes it as inserted by Act 6 of 2022 with effect from 1-10-2022. Where it applies it makes the credit depend on a system-generated restriction communicated under s.38, which cannot be evaluated from a document at all. Recorded as CONFLICT; not adopted.

evidence.section: CGST Act s.16(2)(b) (source A, Act as updated 31-08-2021)
evidence.quote: he has received the goods or services or both.
